title: Well-formedness of the raw block tree
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ sign variables, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction. The raw block tree constructed from $\varphi$ and $\rho$ is well formed relative to the set of all $n$ coordinates: each queried coordinate belongs to the available set at its node, and both child trees are well formed relative to the available set with that coordinate removed.
hypotheses_covered: A disjunctive normal form on those coordinates
